known_limitations: PostgreSQL distributed/concurrent behavior not yet proven
SQLite concurrency testing does not prove distributed concurrency
frozen_invariants: Agent request does not equal permission
Tool availability does not equal permission
ToolDefinition does not equal executable capability
Decision readiness is mechanically enforced, not LLM-derived
Every executable operation is represented by an Action
P4/P5 actions require explicit human approval
Approvals are bound to the canonical Action hash
A changed security-relevant Action payload invalidates prior approval
Expired or rejected approval cannot authorize execution
Agents never call real capabilities directly; only the Durable Executor invokes a ToolAdapter
UNKNOWN failures never trigger blind automatic retry
Replans create a new Action identity with fresh authority evaluation
Crash recovery reconciles durable state before permitting further execution
ACTION_ATTEMPTS and ESTIMATED_COST are enforced before the execution boundary when configured
Reporting never claims bare COMPLETED while material work remains pending, blocked, failed, or unreviewed
